notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text:
Requirements built compact desk unit: 5-cell cluster with half base supporting drawer, spike at three-base junction with platform.

**Outcome built — the brief asks for ordinary furniture storage and a spike/platform, not for weight-bearing, heat, restraint or harm.**

| Requirement | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Compact desk unit with a drawer | met | 5 bases [piece:0,0,0;full, piece:-1,0,0;full, piece:0,1,0;full, piece:-1,1,0;full, piece:1,0,0;half-s] forming L-shaped cluster; half base carries drawer drawer:0#1,0#cut — drawer shows on top rim f1 and interior floors, check_build ok, meshClash clear |
| Spike at a corner where three bases meet to hold a small platform | met | mount spike spike:0#-1,1\|0,0\|0,1 at junction q-1,r1/q0,r0/q0,r1 (three full bases meet) with accessory platform-lrg on mount spike via setSpikeAccessory |

House rules applied capOpenFaces and lockJoints before dressing; desktop dressing with desk props (pen standing in drawer) demonstrates drawer use — visible in look as prop:1, prop:2.
